_comment: The team roster rendered into about.html by scripts/build.mjs. Names are run through js/public-byline.js at render time, so a full name here still reaches the page as 'First L.'. Photo is optional: leave it null and the card falls back to an initials monogram. Appearing here is opt-in, so 'size' is the team's real headcount and 'members' is only those cleared to be named.

teams.name: Outreach
teams.blurb: Brings Commission Watch to schools, community meetings and partner organizations, and recruits the Watchdogs who show up at the BCC.
